Adjacent paragraphs in a layout-table cell are separated rather than concatenated into one run of text

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<table><tr><td><p><b>Alice Example</b></p><p><i>Customer Service</i></p></td><td>Logo</td></tr><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td><td>C</td></tr></table>", options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("compact_tables" = TRUE), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result$content)
```
